seo_guide.title: Comprehensive Guide to AI Tarot
seo_guide.intro_title: Bridging Ancient Wisdom with Modern Tech
seo_guide.intro_text: Tarot has been a tool for reflection for centuries. By integrating Large Language Models (LLM), we preserve the soulful archetypes while eliminating human error and bias. Our algorithm respects the traditional 'Hero's Journey' structure while adapting to modern context.
seo_guide.history_text: Originating in 15th century Italy, tarot started as a card game but evolved into a powerful tool for divination in the late 18th century. The imagery is deeply rooted in Renaissance art, Christian mysticism, and Kabbalah.
seo_guide.accuracy_text: Our system is trained on thousands of verified readings and psychological texts. It validates patterns across millions of data points to ensure that every reading resonates with emotional truth and logical consistency.
